title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Job Title: Accounts Assistant

Location: Aylesbury (Office Based)

Contract Details: Permanent, Full-Time

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm (1 hour lunch break)

Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 per annum, depending on experience

Holiday entitlement: 23 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Responsibilities:

Sales Ledger
- Process and manage all sales invoices accurately and efficiently
- Update job records and maintain invoice filing systems
- Post customer receipts and maintain Sage records
- Undertake credit control activities, chasing overdue payments and monitoring aged debt
- Process new credit account applications, including credit checks
- Respond to customer account queries and maintain excellent service levels

Purchase Ledger
- Match supplier invoices against purchase orders and delivery notes
- Process authorised supplier invoices onto Sage using correct nominal codes
- Investigate and monitor disputed invoices
- Reconcile supplier statements and resolve discrepancies
- Process employee expenses and company credit card transactions
- Assist with supplier account maintenance and payment reconciliations

Skills and Attributes:
- Previous Sales Ledger and Purchase Ledger experience is essential
- Experience using Sage account software is beneficial
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- Confident communicator with a professional telephone manner
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workloads effectively
- Proactive approach with strong problem-solving skills
- Strong numerical and analytical abilities

title: Accounts Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join an established international business based in Aylesbury.
Reporting to the number one of Finance , you'll play an important role in the day-to-day running of the finance function, with exposure across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control, banking and month-end.
This is a varied, hands-on position where no two days will be exactly the same.
Your new role
Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing supplier invoices and payments
- Reconciling supplier statements and intercompany accounts
- Managing supplier queries and maintaining accurate account records
- Processing expenses and supporting accruals and prepayments
- Issuing customer statements and following up outstanding balances
- Resolving customer payment and pricing queries
- Raising invoices and credit notes
- Completing monthly bank reconciliations
- Reconciling retail sales, card payments, settlements and associated fees
- Supporting month-end reporting and audit requirements
- Assisting the Finance Manager with ad hoc projects and process improvements

What you'll need to succeed
You'll be an experienced finance professional with a strong eye for detail, a methodical approach and a genuine problem-solving mindset.
Ideally, you'll have worked in a similar hands-on finance role, with the confidence to investigate discrepancies, resolve complex queries and see issues through to completion.You'll ideally bring:
- Experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and account reconciliations
- Experience investigating and resolving complex financial queries
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail
- A proactive, analytical and problem-solving approach
- Good Excel skills and previous experience using accounting software
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
- Confidence communicating with suppliers, customers and colleagues
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a wider team

An AAT qualification or equivalent would be beneficial but is not essential.
You'll also have an interest in developing your systems knowledge and embracing new technology, including the appropriate use of AI tools to support financial processes and improve efficiency.
What you'll get in return
This is a great opportunity if you're looking for a role that offers more variety and responsibility than a traditional transactional finance position.You'll gain exposure across several areas of the finance function while working closely with the Finance Manager within an established international business.The package includes:
- £35,000-£38,000 depending on experience
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Hybrid working two days per week from home
- Flexible working around standard hours of 9am-5pm

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or contact us directly for further information.

title: Administrator
description:
We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Administrator to join our growing team in Aylesbury. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator with strong data entry, document control, and Microsoft Office skills to support the smooth day-to-day operation of a busy project environment.

The successful candidate will play a key role in managing project documentation, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring information is logged, tracked, and distributed efficiently. A keen eye for detail and strong Excel skills are essential for this position.

The position is for three months with a view to offer long term work.

Monday to Friday 8am 5pm

Key Responsibilities
- Perform accurate data entry and maintain project databases and records.
- Manage document control processes, including issuing, filing, tracking, and archiving documents.
- Ensure all project documentation is up-to-date, correctly formatted, and stored in accordance with company procedures.
- Maintain spreadsheets and reports using Microsoft Excel.
- Monitor document revisions and maintain document registers.
- Support project teams with administrative tasks and document requests.
- Manage incoming and outgoing documentation from clients, suppliers, and project stakeholders.

title: Associate Administrative Support
description:
Nordson Test & Inspection, a global leader in world-class metrology equipment and inspection systems, is seeking a highly motivated and talented Associate Administrative Support to join our team in Aylesbury, United Kingdom. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we are looking for candidates who share that same commitment.

Summary of the Role

Responsible for expediting, orderbook management, and administrative support activities required to support manufacturing operations. The role acts as a key interface between Nordson, its suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring timely communication of supply status, delivery commitments, and potential risks.

Key responsibilities include monitoring supplier performance against required delivery dates, expediting critical and overdue orders, maintaining accurate ERP system data, preparing reports, coordinating communication between suppliers and internal teams, and providing administrative support to the Supply Chain function. The position requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, where your ideas and contributions will be valued and respected.

This position is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract.

Role and Responsibilities

Supplier Coordination & Expediting
- Act as the primary point of contact with suppliers regarding delivery schedules, overdue orders, shortages, and supply-related issues.
- Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively expedite orders to support production requirements.
- Run ERP reports to identify overdue purchase orders, material shortages, and potential supply risks.
- Maintain expediting reports and provide timely updates on supplier communications, delivery status, and key risks to relevant stakeholders.
- Update supplier delivery commitments and related information within the ERP system.
- Escalate significant supply or delivery concerns to the Purchasing Manager.
- Liaise with suppliers to obtain accurate delivery information and ensure timely responses to queries.
- Expedite or defer deliveries in line with business requirements and production schedules.
- Maintain visibility of critical material shortages and communicate risks appropriately.
- Work closely with Planning, Sales, Purchasing, Stores, Manufacturing, and Customer Service teams to ensure effective communication of material availability and delivery commitments.
- Support the resolution of day-to-day supply chain issues affecting operational performance.

Orderbook Management
- Monitor open purchase orders to ensure delivery dates remain accurate and current.
- Review and maintain orderbook data to support effective planning and scheduling activities.
- Ensure ERP records accurately reflect supplier commitments and material availability.
- Identify and investigate discrepancies within purchasing and supplier records.
- Produce regular reports relating to overdue orders, supplier performance, and delivery risks.

Administrative Support
- Provide administrative support to individuals, small teams, and the wider Supply Chain department.
- Prepare correspondence, reports, presentations, spreadsheets, meeting agendas, and minutes using Microsoft Office applications.
- Maintain department files, records, documentation, and electronic filing systems, ensuring appropriate record retention and document control in accordance with company procedures.
- Act as the first point of contact for warehouse and stores-related queries, ensuring issues are directed to the appropriate person where required.
- Prepare and maintain supplier records, procurement documentation, and departmental reports.
- Assist with data entry and the maintenance of ERP and other business systems.
- Support departmental meetings through scheduling, preparation of documents, and distribution of meeting notes where required.

Continuous Improvement
- Support the implementation of supply chain best practices and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, data accuracy, and supplier performance.
- Maintain compliance with company procedures, quality standards, business processes, and ERP data requirements.
- Support departmental and organisational objectives through effective teamwork and communication.
- Perform any other reasonable duties as required by management.

Skills and Qualifications
- Good standard of education.
- A-Level, HNC, or equivalent qualification, or relevant experience.
- Experience in a manufacturing, supply chain, planning, administration, customer service, or similar business environment.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise work, manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate data records.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to build effective relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently, use initiative, make sound decisions, and proactively resolve issues.
- Adaptable and flexible approach to changing priorities.
- Ability to work effectively within a team environment.
- Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement.

Preferred Skills and Qualifications
- Experience in expediting, supplier coordination, or orderbook management.
- Experience working with ERP/MRP systems.
- SAP experience.
- Understanding of manufacturing and supply chain processes.
- Experience communicating with suppliers and managing delivery-related issues.
- Knowledge of MRP, Kanban, Lean Manufacturing, or similar planning methodologies.

About Nordson Test & Inspection

Nordson Test & Inspection manufactures world-class metrology equipment and inspection systems to ensure electronic products are built to meet the highest standards. We use X-ray inspection, acoustic imaging, and optical inspection technologies to create testing systems that enable the identification of even the smallest defects at high resolution. By joining our team today, you will help us bring innovative ideas to life.

Nordson Test & Inspection is a global team that works to create machines and systems that improve the manufacturing process for a wide range of industries, including electronics, aerospace, automotive, energy, lighting, and medical. We offer a supportive culture in a growing and dynamic work environment. Whether you're just beginning your career or you're a seasoned professional, there's a place for you to belong at Nordson Test & Inspection.

We offer hourly and salary positions in production, maintenance, customer service, quality, engineering, and more. We actively invest in our teams to help you build your skillsets and advance your career.

Our recruitment process is designed to identify the best qualified candidates for the role, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process. We are looking for candidates who have a passion for inclusion, diversity and equity, and the ability to contribute to a culture where all employees feel valued, respected, and included.

Interested?

If you are interested in being a part of a team that is dedicated to providing advanced inspection and testing solutions and creating an inclusive and diverse workplace, please apply online with your CV.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: To be responsible for undertaking a wide range of administration duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties can include but are not limited to, scanning and processing of documents, processing and filtering medical reports and letters via DOCMAN; some reception duties including greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, processing of information and assisting patients as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients letters, reports and other such documentation and ensuring the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. Greeting patients and visitors in a professional and friendly manner Answering telephone calls, booking appointments, and handling enquiries Managing patient check-ins and ensuring accurate registration details Processing repeat prescription requests and passing on messages to clinicians Maintaining patient confidentiality at all times Supporting the clinical team with general administrative tasks Filing, scanning, and updating patient records using clinical systems Liaising with other healthcare providers and services as needed Assisting with the smooth day-to-day running of the reception area Ensuring waiting areas remain tidy and welcoming The following are the core responsibilities of the administrator. There may be on occasion, a requirement to carry out other tasks; this will be dependent upon factors such as workload and staffing levels: a. Receive correspondence from external agencies and process accordingly b. Scanning documents to the relevant software programme and logging them c. Filtering documents suitably according to need and passing to the relevant clinicians to read and action d. Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies e. Photocopy documentation as required f. Support administrative staff, providing cover during staff absences g. Input data into the patients healthcare records as necessary h. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner i. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times j. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested k. Completion of administrative tasks in relation to patient results and letters Secondary Responsibilities In addition to the primary responsibilities, the receptionist may be requested to: a. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system b. Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments c. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately d. Signpost patients to the correct service e. Partake in audit as directed by the audit lead f. Action incoming faxes when necessary g. Scanning of patient related documentation and attaching scanned documents to patients healthcare records h. Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the duty rota No canvassers or recruitment agencies, please.
